entry_state: Partial derecognition allocates carrying value by relative fair values, not nominal principal. Retained risk can require a financing liability; continuing guarantee involvement retains both asset and liability until supported satisfaction or expiry.
exit_state: Option labels alone do not decide derecognition. Under the admitted continuing-involvement branch, asset less associated liability represents the retained call; recognising that call again would duplicate the same right.
findings: Practical sale ability and risk-transfer findings precede the conditional option examples.

The retained call moves from value 5 to 9 and then 15; gains 4 and 6 reconcile closing equity 290 against opening 280. Physical exercise removes the liability and retains the already recognised asset. No new defect observed.
